title: PG-04.1 Canonical operation envelope (memev)
request: Programme contract for work package WP04 in memev: Canonical operation envelope. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP04.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP17-03. Depends on contracts: SO-1.04, SO-1.01. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Boundary with SO-1.04 and SO-1.01: WP04 depends on both: the envelope carries the four-way event distinction of SO-1.04 requirement 3 and does not define the adapter contract (SO-1.04 requirement 1) or own the store or coordinator (SO-1.01). Boundary with SO-2.07 to SO-2.11: their adapter layers must use canonical operation contracts: the WP04 envelope is that contract, and these specs do not define any adapter for those systems. Pending owner decision (which layer to build against): the unsigned Scope One fold SO-F-01 to SO-F-13 (cited by id only) overlaps this spec at SO-F-03. Which layer is built against is open and is the owner's call. This spec is not signed until it is decided, and nothing is dropped on the strength of the unsigned fold. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.
